_about: Editable settings for the letters. Change a value here and every new letter follows it. Keys starting with _ are notes only.
_header_unit_line: Printed in blue under «عمادة شؤون الطلاب» at the top right of the letterhead. Set to "" to leave the template header untouched.
_signature: Template wording, confirmed by the center (2026-11-02).
_body_font_size: Body text size in points (the template's own default was 11). Addressee and greeting are printed 1pt larger, closing and signature at least 14pt.
_greeting_font: Leave empty to use the template font (Tosh A Medium). For the calligraphic salam seen on earlier letters use "DecoType Naskh Variants" (must be installed on the computer that opens the file).
_contact: Used for the «للتواصل» line when a letter asks the recipient to coordinate or reply and no other contact person is given.
